title: Afterword — 1942
text:
AFTERWORD—1942

The Savoy College Ex-Student Association deems it a great privilege to be permitted to sponsor the publication of the History of Savoy Male and Female College and acknowledges a debt of gratitude to its author, Miss Mattie Lee Boyd, for the painstaking care and efficient manner in which she assembled and compiled Part I, which constitutes that portion prepared and used by her as a thesis in obtaining an M.A. Degree from the Texas State University, in 1939.

Although discussion was had by ex-students as to publishing this history, following its completion by Miss Boyd, no definite action was taken to that end until the year 1941. At that time a small sum was pledged as a printing fund. The task of completing the undertaking was assigned to the Board of Managers with full power and authority to act. When it was learned that the cost of printing a first edition in limited quantity would be relatively high to insure a popular sale of the book, an underwriting fund was provided to absorb the excess cost. Former students and friends contributing such fund were: Miss Lou A. Arterberry, Mrs. James D. Brewster (in memory of her husband), Lee A. Clark, Harve L. Davis, John Donaghey, John M. Gist, Charles Halsell (in memory of the founder), Fred J. Harle, Walter S. Jenkins, Mrs. Martha Buford May, Charlton H. McGaughey, Ed A. McMahon, Robert McKee, W. Emmett McMahon, Lewis J. Reynolds, Bernice Roberts, Mrs. Beulah Thomasson Stinnett, Gus W. Thomasson, John Urquhart[?], Guy P. Webb, and Mrs. Lemuel (Olivia) Whedbee (in memory of her husband).

We now send this book on its way to your friends and that it may prove informative and encouraging to all who may read it.

E. A. McMAHON, President,
LEWIS J. REYNOLDS,
BEULAH THOMASSON STINNETT,
GUS W. THOMASSON,
Board of Managers.

Dallas, Texas, April, 1942.
notes: Afterword by the Board of Managers; confirms Mattie Lee Boyd authored Part I as a 1939 M.A. thesis at the University of Texas; published 1942. Lists underwriting donors.
